keyVerseDR: "Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight his paths." (Lk 3:4)

level1.title: Prepare the Way
level1.story: God's word came to John in the desert. John said, "Prepare the way of the Lord!" Every valley will be filled, and every mountain made low.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did John say to do?
What can you fix in your heart?
level1.prayer: Jesus, make my heart ready. Amen.

activity.title: Make straight the path
activity.intro: Trace a straight path to Jesus.

level2.title: A Voice Crying in the Wilderness
level2.story: In the fifteenth year of Tiberius Caesar, the word of the Lord came to John, the son of Zechariah, in the desert. He went through the country around the Jordan, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins. As Isaiah wrote, "Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight His paths." Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low. "And all flesh shall see the salvation of God."
level2.keyLine: Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight his paths.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why does Luke name real rulers and places?
What 'mountain' in your heart needs lowering?
level2.prayer: Lord, make my heart a straight path for You. Amen.

activity.title: Memory verse
activity.intro: Read it, fold one line at a time, and say it from memory.
activity.question: What did Isaiah say John would cry out?
activity.answer: Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight His paths.

art.mainBrief: John the Baptist in the wilderness; a road being smoothed
art.heartBrief: Heart drawn as a path with stones; footprints
